light.notes: Nord publishes no light variant; this one is built from its Snow Storm and Polar Night groups. bg nord5, paper nord6, chip nord4; border-hover derived (nord4 toward nord3); text-3 is nord3 brightened; aurora colours as published, pale on light

dark.notes: bg nord0, paper nord1, chip nord2, border-hover nord3; primary nord8 is Nord's primary accent; blue nord9. red is nord11 lifted from 56% to 67% lightness so red text meets 3:1 on nord2. Its tone roles stay pinned to nord11, and on-red is nord0 since white ink falls to 2.7 on the lifted fill (MAD-372)
